definitions.explanation: to toss or hurl something into a container, space, or situation

examples.japanese: ゴミを{箱|はこ}に{投|な}げ{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I threw the garbage into the bin.

examples.japanese: {手紙|てがみ}をポストに{投|な}げ{込|こ}む。
examples.english: I drop a letter into the mailbox.

examples.japanese: {池|いけ}に{石|いし}を{投|な}げ{込|こ}んで{遊|あそ}んだ。
examples.english: We played by throwing stones into the pond.

notes:
FORMATION:
{投|な}げる (to throw) + {込|こ}む (into) → to throw into

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb - takes を for the thrown object and に for the destination.

PATTERN:
XをYに{投|な}げ{込|こ}む = throw X into Y

RELATED ～{込|こ}む COMPOUND VERBS:
- {飛|と}び{込|こ}む (to jump into)
- {迷|まよ}い{込|こ}む (to wander into)
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}む (to rush into)
- {入|はい}り{込|こ}む (to enter)
